steps.text: Asks for the Wine 11 engine r15 or newer. On the default engine the game starts but never opens a window, on every graphics mode (highball#232, reproduced on an M4 on 2026-10-01). On the Wine 11 engine it opens, shows Blizzard's account link screen on a first start, and a player on an M5 Pro reports it plays flawlessly (2026-10-05). Everything installed in the environment stays.
